title: Written Orders, Order-Based Authorization and Program Activation — Wound Care Supply Program
content:
# Written orders, order-based authorization and activation — Wound Care Supply Program

Documentation standard for the written orders, authorization grants and clinical documents of a wound care program.

## 1. The written order

Every shipment on the Wound Care Supply Program rests on a written order from the treating prescriber that names the item, the billing units per 30 days, the order date and the prescriber's NPI. A written order on file for the item is the basis on which an authorization grant is recorded and on which a prior authorization request is made.

## 2. Validity of the written order

The order is valid for the tier's written order validity, in calendar months counted from its order date. The valid-through date is the day before the same calendar day that many months later (falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist), and Larkfield records that valid-through date when the order is received.

*Hypothetical example.* With a written order validity of 3 months, an order dated 2026-01-15 reaches the same calendar day three months later on 2026-04-15; the valid-through date recorded is the day before, 2026-04-14.

## 3. Authorization on tiers without prior authorization

On tiers where prior authorization is not required, Larkfield records the authorization grant itself on the basis of the written order — basis written order, or self-pay order on the Wound Care Self-Pay Program — valid from the order date through the order's valid-through date, for the billing units the order covers within that span.

Each authorization grant credits its authorized billing units to the program. The program's authorized units are the billing units still available to ship under its authorization grants: credited by each grant and by accepted returns, and debited by each refill shipment.

## 4. Activation

A program is activated only when an authorization grant on file for the program is valid on the activation date.

| Program status | How the program becomes active |
|---|---|
| Referral received, on a tier without prior authorization | the written order is on file and its order-based authorization grant is recorded |
| Pending authorization | the payer approves the prior authorization and the approval is recorded as an authorization grant |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical grant valid 2026-02-01 through 2026-04-30).* Activation on 2026-04-30: the grant is valid on that date, so the program may be activated. Activation on 2026-05-01: the grant is no longer valid on that date, so it does not support activation.

## 5. Clinical documents

Clinical documents are recorded with the purpose they serve and the visit date they document, and a document serves only the purpose recorded on it. A visit note recorded as a wound evaluation, for instance, serves as a wound evaluation and not as a record of another purpose.
